name: Add stock
description: Add some of an item to stock, e.g. after shopping. With a price or shop, it's kept in the purchase history too.

item.description: The item: its name or alias ("loo roll"), barcode, or id

quantity.description: How many, in the item's own unit (default 1), or in `unit`

place.description: Where it goes: a place name or code like "G2-4". Defaults to its usual place.

expires_on.description: Expiry date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today plus its shelf life.

brand.description: Which of the item's brands or packs it is

price.description: What was paid for them all, e.g. 3.20 (kept in the purchase history)

shop.description: The shop they were bought at (kept in the purchase history)

unit.description: What the quantity is in, if not the item's own unit: its pack, e.g. "box" (1 box = 20 tea bags)

name: Use stock
description: Take some of an item out of stock (soonest-expiring first). Rechargeables go flat instead. For things Larder takes out by itself (a tea bag a day), this is an extra one; to start a new one now (a sensor that came off early) set opened.

item.description: The item: its name or alias ("loo roll"), barcode, or id

quantity.description: How many, in the item's own unit (default 1), or in `unit`

place.description: Only use stock from this place

opened.description: True if it was opened and is still being used (a new jar of coffee: it shows as open until finish_item), or, for something Larder takes out by itself, a new one started now

note.description: Why, kept in its history, e.g. "Thrown away: out of date"

unit.description: What the quantity is in, if not the item's own unit: its pack, e.g. "box" (1 box = 20 tea bags)

name: Finished the open one
description: The open one of an item is finished (the butter's gone), or the one in use is stopped: none is open, and Larder stops taking them out until one is started again.

item.description: The item: its name or alias ("loo roll"), barcode, or id

name: Move item
description: Move an item to another place: for now (out of place) or for good (its usual place changes).

item.description: The item: its name or alias ("loo roll"), barcode, or id

to.description: The place it's going to: a name or code

permanent.description: True if this is its new usual place

from.description: Only move stock from this place, or "to sort" for stock with no place yet (put away for good)

name: Put back
description: Put an out-of-place item back in its usual place.

item.description: The item: its name or alias ("loo roll"), barcode, or id

from.description: Only what's out of place in this place (default all of it)

name: Add expected delivery
description: Record something ordered but not arrived yet. It counts towards stock, so it isn't bought twice. If it's in a pending order from the same shop (a filled online basket), that is confirmed instead of adding it again.

item.description: The item: its name or alias ("loo roll"), barcode, or id

quantity.description: How many, in the item's own unit (default 1), or in `unit`

source.description: Where it's coming from, e.g. "Tesco delivery" or "Amazon"

unit.description: What the quantity is in, if not the item's own unit: its pack, e.g. "box" (1 box = 20 tea bags)

price.description: What the order says the line costs, e.g. 4.50: kept in the purchase history when it arrives

place.description: Where it goes when it arrives: a place name or code. Defaults to its usual place

pending.description: True if the order isn't confirmed yet (a filled online basket before checkout)

name: Confirm order
description: A pending order went ahead (e.g. the online basket was checked out): it's on its way. A whole order by its source, or one item's.

name: Remove pending order
description: A pending order didn't go ahead (the basket wasn't checked out): it stops counting towards stock, so what's still low is bought next time.

name: Mark arrived
description: A delivery arrived: everything from a source, or some of one item.

quantity.description: How many of the item arrived (default all expected)

due_by.description: With a source: only what was due by this day (YYYY-MM-DD), so a later order from the same shop stays on its way

name: Add to shopping list
description: Put an item on the shopping list even though it isn't low.

item.description: The item: its name or alias ("loo roll"), barcode, or id

name: Remove from shopping list
description: Take an item that was added by hand off the shopping list.

item.description: The item: its name or alias ("loo roll"), barcode, or id

name: Mark charged
description: Rechargeable batteries: some flat ones have been charged.

item.description: The item: its name or alias ("loo roll"), barcode, or id

quantity.description: How many, in the item's own unit (default 1), or in `unit`

name: Renew
description: A renewal (insurance, MOT, boiler service) has been renewed: restart its clock from today.

item.description: The item: its name or alias ("loo roll"), barcode, or id

name: Find item
description: Look up an item: how many, where, and when it expires.

item.description: The item: its name or alias ("loo roll"), barcode, or id

name: Shopping list for a shop
description: Everything to buy at a shop: its favourites plus "any shop" items in categories it sells.

name: Batteries replaced
description: New batteries went into a device: takes them out of stock (rechargeables count as flat until charged).

device.description: The device, by name or Home Assistant device id

name: Bring in shop favourites
description: Reads an online shop's favourites and puts new ones (not linked to an item, not dismissed) in Larder's Pending list. For a schedule, e.g. weekly.

shop.description: The shop, e.g. Tesco. Leave out for the default online shop
